rules: No therapy recommendation or claim that griefbots cure or cause illness.
Qualitative self-reports and public perceptions are not causal estimates or population prevalence.
Speculative ethics scenarios are not observed events.
No dialogue attributed to a deceased individual; no private interviews or customer material.
Retain distinct evidence, uncertainty and editorial inference in all sections.
